node.title: XR split-pencil counterexamples contain bounded Maxwell-dense cores
node.statement: Any genuine GRS_4 split-pencil family of (4+c)-blocks with c|F|>=2N-8 contains an inclusion-minimal subfamily G with c|G|=2|union G|-8+e, 0<=e<=c-1, while every proper J has c|J|<=2|union J|-9. Each block has at most floor((c-1-e)/2) private coordinates, and the stacked parity matrix has left nullity at least e+1, one beyond ordinary overdetermination. Official P-A core sizes are at most 308/359/640 and P-B one-loop core sizes at most 256/299/480. This is a bounded anomalous-core extraction, not its classification.
